name: clinichall
description: Scientific longevity and exercise physiology research connector for ClinicHall (clinichall.com): LOINC biochemical taxonomy benchmarks, VO2max & HRV physiology datasets, mathematical longevity indices, and SHA-256 verification.
suggestedPrompts: Synthétise les référentiels scientifiques de longévité et de physiologie de l'exercice dans ClinicHall
Liste les marqueurs biochimiques LOINC (ApoB, HbA1c, hs-CRP) et leurs valeurs optimales issues de la littérature
Recherche dans le corpus bibliographique ClinicHall les publications sur la VO2max et la longévité

review.commerce_description: This plugin is a read-only scientific and educational research connector and does not sell products or process payments.

positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_longevity_research_overview and returns a summary of the indexed LOINC biochemical benchmarks, exercise physiology reference metrics, and mathematical longevity models.
positive.prompt: Give me an overview of the scientific longevity and exercise physiology reference benchmarks in ClinicHall.

positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_loinc_biomarker_benchmarks and returns LOINC-coded biochemical markers (ApoB, Lp(a), HbA1c, hs-CRP, HOMA-IR, Vitamin D3, Omega-3 index) with standard and longevity literature reference ranges.
positive.prompt: List the LOINC biochemical reference benchmarks and optimal literature ranges in ClinicHall.

positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_longevity_index_formulas and returns published mathematical models and reference indices (Levine PhenoAge, ESC SCORE2, FINDRISC, FIB-4).
positive.prompt: Show the mathematical longevity index formulas and reference models in ClinicHall.

positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_physiology_telemetry_benchmarks and returns reference exercise physiology series (HRV RMSSD, sleep architecture, VO2max).
positive.prompt: Show the exercise physiology reference datasets for HRV, sleep architecture, and VO2max in ClinicHall.

positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_scientific_literature and returns indexed scientific bibliography entries matching the query.
positive.prompt: Search the ClinicHall scientific bibliography for ApoB and lipid biochemistry.

interface.longDescription: Connect your ClinicHall scientific research workspace (clinichall.com) to explore LOINC-coded biochemical reference benchmarks, exercise physiology telemetry datasets (HRV RMSSD, sleep cycle architecture, aerobic capacity VO2max), mathematical longevity models (Levine PhenoAge, metabolic indices), micronutrition biochemistry tables, longitudinal research cohorts, and SHA-256 cryptographic document verification.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the longevity science and exercise physiology reference benchmarks in ClinicHall.
List the LOINC biochemical reference ranges for ApoB, HbA1c, and hs-CRP in ClinicHall.
Search the ClinicHall scientific bibliography for VO2max and longevity research.

publication.release_notes: Release 1.0.1: Updated ClinicHall MCP connector and onboarding skill to focus exclusively on educational and scientific longevity research, LOINC biochemical reference benchmarks, exercise physiology datasets (VO2max, HRV), academic bibliography search, and SHA-256 document verification across 12 read-only tools.

fr-FR.subtitle: Longévité & physiologie
fr-FR.description: Connectez ClinicHall (clinichall.com) pour explorer les référentiels scientifiques de biochimie (nomenclature LOINC : ApoB, HbA1c, hs-CRP), la physiologie de l'exercice (VO2max, HRV), les modèles mathématiques de longévité et la littérature académique.
